title: 第5章 一剑九影第6章 养血功圆满
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
张宿的目光望向了王海身后。
王海似乎知道张宿在找什么。
他冷笑道：“不用找了，他们没来。而且，就算他们来了，你以为他们还会帮你？”
“实话告诉你，其实就是杜天三人找到了我。就他们三人那点心思，我又岂会不知道？想借我的手教训你罢了，不过，我不在意。”
看着王海那狰狞的表情，张宿明白了。
原来是杜天三人……
难怪此前，杜天三人似乎很希望他出去。
原来是早就找了王海，想教训他。
想想此前一年，张宿还把好东西都给了杜天三人。
结果……
这就是人心！
“怪只怪你那赘婿大哥，一年了，我的火很大！不狠狠教训你，难消我心头之恨！”
王海恨恨地说道。
看来，他是真恨极了张宿的大哥。
忽然，张宿笑了。
他眼睛微微一眯：“有没有人告诉过你一句话？”
“什么？”
“你的废话太多了……”
此话一出，王海勃然大怒。
“你……”

可是没等王海说出口，张宿的手便握在了剑柄上。
“铿”。
一声清脆的拔剑声，传入了王海的耳中。
张宿拔剑了。
他刚刚才兑换的冷霜剑，第一次出鞘！
顿时，一道耀眼的白光闪过。
“区区气血境一层，也敢对我拔剑？”
王海虽然愤怒，但并不惊慌。
他可是气血境三层。
而且，在剑法造诣上也极高。
他也瞬间拔剑。
可当他仔细一看，只感觉眼前一晃，张宿的剑怎么消失了？
不，不是消失了。
而是化为了六道剑影。
可是，怎么会有六道剑影？
哪一道是真的？
哪一道又是假的？
分不清。
根本分不清。
何况，张宿这一剑速度之快，几乎转瞬即至。

王海几乎本能般施展剑法，在身前舞出了剑花，试图抵挡张宿的这一剑。
“叮叮叮”。
王海感到手中的剑猛的一震。
content_en:
Zhang Su looked behind Wang Hai.
Wang Hai seemed to know what Zhang Su was looking for.
He sneered: "No need to look for it, they didn't come. And even if they came, do you think they would still help you?"
"To tell you the truth, it was actually Du Tian and the others who found me. How could I not know the thoughts of the three of them? I just wanted to teach you a lesson with my hands, but I don't care."
Looking at Wang Hai's ferocious expression, Zhang Su understood.
It turned out to be Du Tian and the others...
No wonder Du Tian and the others seemed to want him to go out before.
It turned out that Wang Hai had been looking for him a long time ago and wanted to teach him a lesson.
Think about it, a year ago, Zhang Su gave all the good things to Du Tian and the others.
The result...
This is the human heart!
"The only thing to blame is your son-in-law. It's been a year and I'm very angry! If I don't teach you a lesson, it's hard to eliminate the hatred in my heart!"
Wang Hai said bitterly.
It seems that he really hates Zhang Su's eldest brother.
Suddenly, Zhang Su smiled.
He narrowed his eyes slightly: "Has anyone ever told you something?"
"What?"
"You talk too much nonsense..."
As soon as these words came out, Wang Hai became furious.
"You..."
But before Wang Hai could say anything, Zhang Su's hand was on the hilt of the sword.
"Keng".
A clear sound of sword drawing reached Wang Hai's ears.
Zhang Su drew his sword.
The Frost Sword he had just exchanged was unsheathed for the first time!
Suddenly, a dazzling white light flashed.
"You're only at the first level of Qi and Blood Realm, but you dare to draw your sword against me?"
Although Wang Hai was angry, he was not panicked.
He is at the third level of Qi and Blood Realm.
Moreover, he is also extremely skilled in swordsmanship.
He also drew his sword instantly.
But when he took a closer look, he felt a flicker in front of his eyes. Why did Zhang Su's sword disappear?
No, it didn't disappear.
Instead, it turned into six sword shadows.
But, how come there are six sword shadows?
Which one is true?
Which one is fake?
Can't tell.
Can't tell the difference at all.
What's more, Zhang Su's sword was so fast that it came almost instantly.
Wang Hai used his sword skills almost instinctively and danced sword flowers in front of him, trying to resist Zhang Su's sword.
"Ding ding ding".
Wang Hai felt the sword in his hand shake violently.
